_comment: contract version: 4. Function declarations Brain registers with Gemini.

tools.name: search_odyssey
tools.description: Search the Odyssey text and episode notes. Returns passages with ids like '12.14' (book.paragraph).

tools.name: find_episode
tools.description: Find the Odyssey episodes that best match a user's real-life problem.

tools.name: highlight_passage
tools.description: Highlight passages on the stage while you talk about them.

tools.name: show_scene
tools.description: Show a scene image on the stage (or send it as an attachment in text mode).

tools.name: show_map
tools.description: Show the journey map focused on a location.

tools.name: switch_character
tools.description: Hand the conversation to another character.

tools.name: start_debate
tools.description: Stage a short debate between Odysseus (left) and Poseidon (right) about the user's dilemma, 2-3 turns each, then ask the user to pick a side.

topic.description: The user's dilemma as a one-line question.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End the session with a short 'Your Ithaca' takeaway: the lesson plus one action for this week, 2 sentences.

action.description: One concrete action for this week, starting with a verb.

tools.name: find_moment
tools.description: Story Mode: find a story moment to narrate (e.g. 'the wooden horse', 'escaping the cyclops'). Returns its beats: illustration, gesture, passage ids and an exact quote for each.

tools.name: set_story_mode
tools.description: Turn Story Mode on (when the user asks you to tell or explain part of the story) or off (when the telling is done). Pass the moment_id from find_moment when turning it on.

tools.name: show_illustration
tools.description: Story Mode: show a large illustration of an object or creature on the stage while you describe it (e.g. 'trojan-horse'). Use ids from find_moment beats.

tools.name: gesture
tools.description: Make a hand gesture on the stage while you speak: point (at the picture), open (explaining, palms up), raise (triumph or alarm), heart (feeling, sincerity), think (hand to chin), none (hands down).

tools.name: explain_idea
tools.description: Bring up the screen with a philosophy board: name the idea at the heart of the user's question and show 2-3 gods' viewpoints on it, with an illustration. Use for 'why', 'what does it mean', 'is it right to' questions.

title.description: The idea, e.g. 'Nostos: the longing for home'

illustration_id.description: From the illustration list in your instructions

stance.description: One sentence, in that god's voice

tools.name: start_adventure
tools.description: Start 'Be Odysseus': the user plays Odysseus and makes his choices at nine moments of the voyage. Returns the first decision point.

tools.name: choose
tools.description: Be Odysseus: record the user's choice (A, B or C) at the current decision point. Returns what happens, what Homer's Odysseus did, the new stats and the next decision point (or the ending).

tools.name: end_adventure
tools.description: Leave Be Odysseus early (the user wants to stop).
